description: What the semi-structured surface may and may not do with a FILE value. A FILE value IS an object of file metadata, but live Snowflake does not let the VARIANT surface reach into it. Measured over a populated FILE column: TYPEOF(f), OBJECT_KEYS(f) and f:RELATIVE_PATH are all compile errors naming the FILE type - the ':' operator reports itself as GET - while equality, IS NULL, COUNT and SELECT DISTINCT all work normally. The accessors are the only supported way in, and they need a real FILE: a BARE stage path string is the compile error 'Invalid argument types for function FL_GET_RELATIVE_PATH: (VARCHAR(14))', so the path must be wrapped in TO_FILE. Converted 1:1 from functions/file/FileExpressionRejectionTest (now retired); the class's createPopulatedFileColumn helper is inlined as the first two steps of each test that needs it.

steps.sql: CREATE TABLE fx (id INTEGER, f FILE)
INSERT INTO fx SELECT 1, OBJECT_CONSTRUCT('STAGE', '@D.S.ST', 'RELATIVE_PATH', 'hello.txt', 'SIZE', 24, 'LAST_MODIFIED', 'Mon, 03 Aug 2026 11:24:13 GMT', 'CONTENT_TYPE', 'text/plain', 'ETAG', 'e1')
SELECT TYPEOF(f) FROM fx
CREATE TABLE fx (id INTEGER, f FILE)
INSERT INTO fx SELECT 1, OBJECT_CONSTRUCT('STAGE', '@D.S.ST', 'RELATIVE_PATH', 'hello.txt', 'SIZE', 24, 'LAST_MODIFIED', 'Mon, 03 Aug 2026 11:24:13 GMT', 'CONTENT_TYPE', 'text/plain', 'ETAG', 'e1')
SELECT OBJECT_KEYS(f) FROM fx
CREATE TABLE fx (id INTEGER, f FILE)
INSERT INTO fx SELECT 1, OBJECT_CONSTRUCT('STAGE', '@D.S.ST', 'RELATIVE_PATH', 'hello.txt', 'SIZE', 24, 'LAST_MODIFIED', 'Mon, 03 Aug 2026 11:24:13 GMT', 'CONTENT_TYPE', 'text/plain', 'ETAG', 'e1')
SELECT f:RELATIVE_PATH FROM fx

error.messageContains: Invalid argument types for function 'GET': (FILE, VARCHAR(13))
